column3: The Hebrew heading says he came to Bathsheba; BSB explicitly names adultery.
The Hebrew describes being righteous when speaking rather than an explicit passive proving right; BSB says proved right.
The Hebrew says his mother conceived him in sin; BSB describes him as sinful when she conceived him.
The Hebrew says making him know wisdom; BSB says teaching him wisdom.
The Hebrew says create for me a clean heart; BSB says create in me.
The Hebrew names the spirit of Your holiness; BSB says Your Holy Spirit.
The Hebrew says bloods without a separate guilt term; BSB says bloodguilt.
The Hebrew has a singular burnt offering; BSB has burnt offerings.
The Hebrew separately names a burnt offering and whole offering and uses an active plural for offering bulls; BSB combines whole burnt offerings and makes bulls passively offered.
